name: Fairmont (United States)
description: White field within a black border, charged at the centre with the city seal: a yellow disc with the river and bridges, with red scrolls reading FAIRMONT, THE FRIENDLY CITY and WEST VIRGINIA.
history: Fairmont is a city in Marion County, West Virginia, and its county seat. The flag was adopted on 5 June 1984 (designed by Janice Watts, the winner of a city flag contest announced by city manager Ed Daley, and adopted on 5 June 1984, according to Flags of the World citing the Times West Virginian).
